description: Rewrites a CV for a specific job spec from the evidence in that CV. It reads the role's requirements (or takes the ones check_application returned), drafts using only the terms, dates and figures the source CV supports, checks the draft and corrects it once. ready is true only when nothing in the draft is unsupported; otherwise unsupported_claims lists what to remove before use. requirements shows each one as check_application does. Free anonymous allowance; on exhaustion returns a link to continue on the web app.

cv_markdown.description: The CV in Markdown. On a signed-in connection, omit it to tailor from your saved master CV.

requirements.description: The requirements a check_application call returned for this role. Omit to read them from job_spec.

name: tailor_cv_to_role
title: Tailor a CV to a job
